review_notes: I read the whole file. It adds no new definitions, structures or classes. It has three theorems: `evalAt_add_of_mem`, `ord_unif` and `unif_zpow_mul_mem`, plus the final `solution`. All of them are project-specific facts about `Place`, `evalAt`, `unif`, `poleOrder` and `resFnFun` on the modular curve. They use Mathlib notions such as `ValuationSubring`, `riemannRochSpace`-style membership and `Classical.epsilon_spec`, not rival versions of them. The `attribute [-instance]` and `attribute [-simp]` lines only change local instance and simp sets. They don't introduce a concept. `evalAt_add_of_mem` is additivity of a project-defined residue evaluation, so it is a theorem, not a duplicate concept. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. I didn't search Mathlib for a competing definition. I found no competing declaration in the file to compare against it, so I abstain.
